source_snapshot.procedure: Collect complete IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists, broadly filter GPU, inspect BMC Web and retain anomalies.
source_snapshot.criteria: Both list forms and Web match SPEC; numbering is 1, 2, 99.
source_snapshot.script: No Script; Config-Check; 3/0 minutes; unique code.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES/ipmitool but invents one aggregate item-title sensor and truncates OOB SDR.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/HIGH; requires complete GPU population/topology and type separation for temperature, power, voltage, presence and health.

old_problem: GPU is an inventory scope spanning multiple physical accelerators and incompatible telemetry types, not one sensor. The source does not define expected GPU count, UUID/BDF/SXM/slot mapping, approved member list or type-specific limits. DeepSeek collapses everything into a nonexistent aggregate record; criteria jump from 2 to 99.
disposition_reason: Resolve Pending and Source Conflict by parameterizing the exact GPU inventory, topology and type-specific sensor map under ED-03. ED-19 preserves every physical GPU and each distinct temperature, power, voltage, presence and health checkpoint; ED-15 requires approved per-type limits, and ED-26 prevents similar GPU records from being merged. Full IB/OOB/Web inventories remain mandatory and no GPU action is introduced.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2038, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; the actual next queue row was directly opened as Functionality 2039 / Wistron-BMC-01058-V002 / c2a0dbceeff8b392.
Every physical accelerator is bound using stable UUID plus PCIe BDF/SXM/slot/module identity; volatile GPU index alone is insufficient.
Temperature, power, voltage, presence and health records have different units/state models and are graded only against their own approved type-specific rules.
Complete raw IB/OOB lists and every Web row establish population and expose missing, extra, duplicate, stale or cross-mapped records; a group record cannot hide individual GPUs.
Criteria 1, 2 and 99 are retained; absent criteria 3-98 are not invented.
No ipmitool, nvidia-smi/GPU query, authentication, Web capture, GPU reset/power/configuration/fault injection, log clear or DUT action was performed.

test_case.purpose: Verify every approved GPU temperature, power, voltage, presence and health record is bound to the correct physical GPU UUID/BDF/SXM/slot/module and reports fresh SPEC-consistent fields across IB/OOB SDR, IB/OOB Sensor List and BMC Web.
required_package: SUT/BMC/BIOS/GPU/SXM/PCIe firmware identities and expected accelerator/module population
GPU UUID/BDF/SXM/slot/module/board-zone topology and exact BMC record IDs/types/aliases
Passive workload/power/thermal context, approved ipmitool and optional read-only vendor inventory tool
Protected IB/OOB/Web access, retained GPU/XID/kernel/BMC/SEL evidence and human Web/verdict ownership
test_case.test_command: READ-ONLY PACKAGE-GATED; freeze the expected GPU inventory and passive operating context, preserve logs, and capture complete aligned IB/OOB `sdr elist` and `sensor list` before GPU filtering. Resolve every approved record through UUID/BDF/SXM/slot/module identity, classify its sensor type and capture every corresponding Web row. Compare population, aliases, units/value or raw state, thresholds and freshness to type-specific SPEC. Do not target the item title, rely on GPU index alone, collapse types/modules, reset or reconfigure GPUs, clear logs or retry automatically.
test_case.expected_result: Every expected GPU and approved type-specific record appears exactly once at the correct physical identity with fresh SPEC-valid consistent fields in all supported views, with no missing/duplicate/cross-mapped telemetry, XID or power/thermal alarm.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact UUID/BDF/module inventory, complete typed record map and all supported-view evidence meeting approved per-type rules. FAIL on missing/extra GPU or record, duplicate/stale/cross-mapped telemetry, wrong type/unit/state, view mismatch, exceeded approved limit, XID or thermal/power fault. Missing inventory/map/limits is NOT READY; user owns verdict.
safety_gate: Passive reads only; no GPU reset, power cycle, MIG/clock/power policy, firmware, fault injection or sensor-threshold change.
Bind by UUID and BDF plus physical module; preserve XID/kernel/BMC/SEL evidence and protect credentials.
Stop on inventory ambiguity, missing/duplicate/stale record, XID, power/thermal alarm or channel disagreement.
No automatic retry or log clearing; preserve the first GPU/topology/fault context.
expected_evidence: Exact source and SUT/BMC/BIOS/GPU/SXM/PCIe firmware identity
Expected GPU count and UUID/BDF/SXM/slot/module/zone typed sensor map
Full timestamped IB/OOB SDR and Sensor-list raw outputs with exits/hashes
Complete BMC Web evidence for every approved record
Passive workload/power/thermal plus nvidia-smi/XID/kernel/BMC/SEL context, numbering/no-action/no-clear/no-retry audit and verdict
test_case.recovery: On wrong target/topology, access failure, missing/mismatched telemetry, XID or power/thermal alarm, stop passive collection and preserve state. Close sessions and rotate exposed credentials. Do not reset/reconfigure GPUs, clear logs or retry; escalate exact UUID/BDF/module and record.

source_conflict.reason: A complete UUID/BDF/module-bound typed sensor matrix resolves broad GPU semantics without inventing an aggregate target or allowing one record/type to substitute for another.

blocked.reason: Passive collection, type separation, evidence, safety and recovery are defined; inventory/topology/limits are Project Configuration.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Expected GPU/module population, UUID/BDF/SXM/slot topology, record IDs/types/aliases, per-type limits/freshness and passive operating context.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED TO UUID/BDF-BOUND TYPED GPU SENSOR MATRIX; NO IPMITOOL, GPU QUERY, AUTHENTICATION, WEB CAPTURE, GPU RESET/POWER/CONFIGURATION/FAULT INJECTION, LOG CLEAR OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED
